# Era Widgets

CSS-first, spec-first UI skins for agents. Canonical API is HTML + ew- classes + data-* attrs.
Set personality with data-era on a root. Do not rewrite markup per era.
Load ONLY the sections you need — do not ingest the whole library.

## Quick start
- CSS: @era-widgets/css/era-widgets.css
- MCP: list_eras | get_component | validate | recommend
- Rules: generated/rules/era-widgets.mdc

## Eras (cards: generated/llms/era-<id>.card.txt)
- deco: Jazz-age geometry: stepped edges, vertical emphasis, brass on lacquer. (fidelity ~35)
- earth: Crafted earth tones: clay, moss, sand — quiet organic UI. (fidelity ~30)
- groovy: 70s groove: avocado & harvest gold, soft flares, lazy curves. (fidelity ~40)
- mcm-atomic: Mid-century atomic optimism: kidney shapes, starbursts, teal–coral–mustard. (fidelity ~40)
- memphis: Playful postmodern: squiggles, confetti shapes, loud primaries on cream. (fidelity ~50)
- neon: Synthwave nights: magenta–cyan chrome on deep violet, grid horizon optional. (fidelity ~55)
- neutral: Quiet modern system skin — the default before personality. (fidelity ~0)

## Rules
- Prefer native elements.
- Zero attrs = defaults.
- Glow never counts as contrast.
- Open-license fonts only in default packs.
- Published CSS/JS must import nothing.
